verdict.rationale: Conta Simples documents travel-oriented building blocks: VCNs issued for hotel and air bookings, travel-specific cards, receipts linked to transactions, and categories and cost centers. Nothing in the evidence shows a trip or itinerary entity, or bookings, card spend and receipts being gathered automatically into one trip-linked expense report. Grouping spend through a dedicated card or cost center is a user-side workaround and an adjacent feature, so it earns no credit.
